failure: Failure: Correlated initial pools, hidden-state-dependent selection without a valid proposal representation, controller access to the hidden bulk, and repeated same-pool observations are excluded. Reported speed is a single-run comparison.
interface: Interface: The initial pool is iid and independent of the controller; unrevealed particles evolve independently under known finite-state dynamics. Label selection is independent of hidden states, interactions fit the stated proposal/reveal form, and endpoints depend on controller and aggregate counts or a coarsening.

claims.title: A capped revealed-pool process gives a likelihood error independent of population size
